decisions.reason: A has an explicit strong customer-value signal of more than €600,000 annual savings and fits the firm’s established modular recycling systems, so the option appears to be paying off rather than resolving negatively.

B is close to the core offer and was important enough to receive its own page, so in a growing firm and market it is a relatively low-cost option worth retaining while demand information continues to accumulate.

C is still early and only lightly evidenced, but because it builds on the established offer and likely shares platforms and capabilities, management would usually keep this still-uncertain option for now.

D is close to the firm’s existing screening and processing business, so despite limited visible proof so far the carrying cost is likely moderate and the firm has reason to preserve the option another year.
